post.text:
Pope Leo XIV is anticipated to be in attendance for Notre Dame and Villanova's college basketball doubleheader in Rome on Nov. 1.

The men's teams will play at 9:30 a.m. ET on Fox. The women follow at 12 p.m. ET on FS1.

https://t.co/QDtJu72Xca https://t.co/IuFvh6n1u4
post.author_description: Notre Dame FB & WBB for @BGInews / @On3 | Previously @clarionledger, @thedailytexan, @NFLMedia & @SINow | “An outstanding young reporter” per @Finebaum

description.description: A medium shot of a religious figure, likely a Catholic prelate, wearing a white zucchetto, glasses, and a red and white liturgical vestment decorated with ornate gold embroidery. He is shown from the waist up, smiling and waving both hands towards the viewer. He is flanked by two other men in clerical clothing. The background is a solid, warm brown color.
